blockers.description: REVIEW-1 defeats the D-05 reversal the product owner explicitly approved. They accepted close-on-submit ONLY because a rollback toast's Retry reopened the modal prefilled. That toast auto-dismisses after 5s (app/layout.tsx:27 mounts ToastProvider with no timeout; Base UI default is 5000), and retryValues/retryColumnName are null until Retry fires — so after 6s the whole form is unrecoverable. Verified twice: by a reviewer that ran it, and by reading the provider and the Base UI default.
blockers.workaround: Pass an explicit no-auto-dismiss timeout for the danger/create-failure toasts. use-create-task.ts:76 ALREADY claims 'The failure toast has no auto-dismiss' — the comment is false and describes the intended behaviour.

decisions.decision: Reverse D-05: all three creates (task, board, column) close the modal at submit; a refusal rolls back and raises a toast whose Retry reopens the modal prefilled
decisions.rationale: Product owner drove the running app 2026-09-03 and reported creates as feeling non-optimistic. They were shown the input-loss trade-off explicitly and chose the Retry-prefill option over plain close+toast. Recorded in 02-UI-SPEC.md, 03-UI-SPEC.md and 04-UI-SPEC.md.

decisions.decision: Auth forms gate the POST on client validation; action={dispatch} stays only as the pre-hydration fallback
decisions.rationale: An empty sign-in form POSTed to the server, reproduced in a real browser. RHF was display-only because handleSubmit was never called. RHF's synchronous preventDefault is what stops React also running the form action — verified by three independent reviewers, and empirically (exactly 1 dispatch on a valid submit).

decisions.decision: Password is no longer cleared on a client-side refusal, only on a server ERROR
decisions.rationale: A refusal that never left the browser should not cost the user the correction they were about to make.

The repo's lint bans BOTH React FormEvent and FormEventHandler as deprecated aliases, and the repo has no precedent for typing a raw form submit event. Deriving from the element names no deprecated alias.

decisions.decision: Subtask label uses self-center rather than changing the row's items-start
decisions.rationale: Centres a single-line title (was 4.5px high, measured) and is a no-op once a wrapped title fills the row. NOTE: two reviewers independently flag that the WRAPPED case is now 4.5px misaligned, worse than the 2.5px before — REVIEW-6.
